calculation.description: Ranks assets favoring recent five-trading-day losers, with the reversal magnitude scaled by trailing 20-day return volatility. Signals are clipped for cross-asset robustness. Forward returns are strictly after the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.038019), 2023-2024 (+0.015252), and 2025-2027 (+0.028682). The 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. Longer-horizon decay is weak and turns negative by 10 days.
